failure_condition: WORKPLACES mobility remains below -60% for the next four weeks, but RETAIL_REC shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: The combined sharp decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility signifies a severe reduction in daily commuting and general movement across the metropolitan area. mechanism_narrative: The rapid and widespread decline across multiple public place categories (RETAIL_REC, PARKS, TRANSIT, WORKPLACES) coupled with a sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility signifies a period of tightening government restrictions or a strong public health advisory to stay home. This policy-driven shift will continue to suppress non-essential retail activity, resulting in lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

This could lead to a slight stabilization or minor rebound in the very short term as essential needs or limited permissible activities drive some people out, resulting in higher RETAIL_REC over the next week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to decline or remains flat below -60% for the next week, failing to show any rebound.

candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM drops by more than 15 points week-on-week
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM mobility remains low or recovers, but RETAIL_REC increases significantly over the next two weeks.
